title: DARG: Dynamic Evaluation of Large Language Models via Adaptive Reasoning Graph

bias_targets.target: Social bias against protected groups (including Age, Religion, and Disability)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset through multiple-choice question answering. The authors construct reasoning graphs representing persons and their attributes, and perturb these graphs by dynamically adding pairs of positive and negative attributes to individuals. They then measure pro-bias selections, anti-bias selections, and 'Overall Avoidance Rates' (choosing 'Cannot be determined') as the complexity of the context increases.
